hook.line: Don Hernando does not tell a story, he performs it. At the best part he stops, shakes his head and lets one line do all the work.
hook.en: You should have seen his face!

examples.en: You should have seen his face!
The ideas you come up with!
The stories Hernando comes up with!

rule:
When you can hardly believe how much of something there was, name it with *el / la / los / las* + noun + *que* + verb: *¡La cara que puso!*

The article does not point at one particular face. It turns up the volume, and you leave the sentence hanging.

For what a person comes up with, use *tener cada* + a singular noun: *¡Tienes cada idea!*

Start with *con* for "with how...": *¡Con el frío que hace!*
smallPrint: Teachers call this an exclamative with an intensifying definite article.

yourTurn.prompt: To a friend. Choose *dices* or *dije* and type the whole sentence: *¡Las cosas que ___!* (The things you say!)
yourTurn.why: You are talking about what your friend says, so *dices*.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *el* or *un* and type the whole sentence: *¡Con ___ frío que hace!* (With how cold it is!)
yourTurn.why: The article *el* is the signal; *un* would not make it an exclamation.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: You should have seen his face!
yourTurn.why: Article + noun + *que* + verb, and you stop there.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: What a fright I got!
yourTurn.why: The same frame works for any noun, with *me llevé* for "I got".

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish, to a friend: The ideas you come up with!
yourTurn.why: *Tener cada* + a singular noun says "the ideas you have".

yourTurn.prompt: Say it about Hernando: *¡Tienes cada historia!* (The stories Hernando comes up with!)
Type in Spanish: The jokes Hernando tells!
yourTurn.why: A plural thing takes *los*, and the verb after *que* is his.

pitfalls.why: Almost. The article is what makes it an exclamation, so keep it.
Almost. *Cada* always goes with a singular noun.
Almost. Keep the article after *con*: *el frío que hace*.

personal: Think of someone who surprised you recently. React in one line, like Don Hernando, with *¡La cara que puso!* or *¡Tienes cada idea!*.
